# AWS Budgets

Store budget, notification and subscriber definitions with tags; no AWS costs are calculated or notifications delivered.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `budgets` |
| Signing name | `budgets` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2016-10-20` |
| Scope | Account-wide |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 16 of 26 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-budgets) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No actual spend, forecasts, cost data, budget evaluation or notification delivery; caller-supplied notification state is stored without evaluation.
- Budget actions, performance history, account notification history, auto-adjustment, billing views and modern filter expressions/metrics are unsupported.
- No CloudFormation handlers: AWS::Budgets::Budget and AWS::Budgets::BudgetsAction, CDK and awscc deployment are unavailable.
- No automatic expiration, planned-limit rollover or AWS cost refresh timing; planned limits are retained as definitions.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
